fees.title: Taskee Fees & Pricing
fees.subtitle: Simple, transparent pricing designed to reward loyal taskees

structure.title: Taskee Fee Structure
structure.description: At BitTasker, we believe in rewarding loyalty. The more tasks you complete, the less you pay in fees. Our dynamic tier system ensures that our most active taskees enjoy the best rates.
structure.note: Save money as you use BitTasker! Our unique tier system rewards active taskees with progressively lower fees.

1.title:
Nakamoto
Newbie
1.criteria: For taskees who complete 0–3 tasks in the last 30 days
1.example: Example: For a $100 task, you'll receive $87.50 (minus $0.05-$0.10 network fees, not paid to BitTasker).

2.title:
Satoshi
Stacker
2.criteria: For taskees who complete 4–10 tasks in the last 30 days
2.example: Example: For a $100 task, you'll receive $90 (minus $0.05-$0.10 network fees, not paid to BitTasker).

3.title:
Hash
Master
3.criteria: For our most active taskees with 11+ tasks in the last 30 days
3.example: Example: For a $100 task, you'll receive $92.50 (minus $0.05-$0.10 network fees, not paid to BitTasker).

bitcoin.title: Bitcoin Payments: Keep More of What You Earn
bitcoin.description: Earn even more when taskers pay with Bitcoin! We offer reduced fees for Bitcoin transactions.
bitcoin.example: Bitcoin Example: As a Hash Master tier taskee, a $100 task paid with Bitcoin would net you $98.50 instead of $92.50!

repeat.title: Repeat Tasker Bonus
repeat.description: Establish strong tasker relationships and enjoy significantly reduced fees on repeat work!

benefits.title: Taskee Benefits & Visibility
benefits.description: Higher tier taskees enjoy additional benefits beyond reduced fees:
benefits.item_1: Enhanced Visibility: Higher tier taskees appear at the top of search results
benefits.item_2: Badge Recognition: Earn prestigious tier badges displayed on your profile
benefits.item_3: Bid Priority: Your proposals are highlighted and prioritized in taskees' inboxes
benefits.item_4: Competitive Edge: Taskers can see your tier status, giving you an advantage

maintenance.title: Tier Advancement & Maintenance
maintenance.description: Your tier status is calculated based on your activity over the past 30 days, and is updated daily. The more tasks you complete, the higher your tier and the lower your fees.

cta.title: Ready to start earning with the most competitive fees in the industry?

repeat_bonus.title: Returning Taskers = Higher Earnings!
repeat_bonus.description: When a tasker books you for a repeat task:
repeat_bonus.note_1: Example: For a $100 repeat task, you'll earn $97 with standard payment or $99 with Bitcoin!
repeat_bonus.note_2: Booking repeat work with a tasker counts towards your 30 day rolling tasks to maintain your tier.
